text:
Type: plug-in wall sconce
Use: reading and ambient light; bedroom, living room, home office; mounted beside a bed or sofa
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: frosted glass shade, faux wood cap, brushed nickel arm and oval backplate
Colors: white, warm medium wood, silver nickel
Shape: acorn-shaped capsule shade hanging from a curved hook arm, oval wall plate with rocker switch, slim and compact
Feel: warm, soft, friendly
Goes with: wood furniture, white or warm walls, nickel accents; mid-century or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Oval Plug-In Light Wall Sconce - 8.5 x 4.25 x 13 Inches, Faux Wood and Nickel
product.description: This Mid-century modern wall sconce has an oval-shaped glass diffuser that will provide warm, ambient light for a bedroom. The opal glass, faux wood socket and metal hardware with a brushed nickel finish give it both modern and vintage touches. 8.5"W x 4.25"D x 13.5"H Faux wood socket, metal arm and wall plate, glass shade Convenient plug-in sconce provides soft light. Rotary on/off switch. Easily assembled and mounted on wall Intended for indoor use only
